earlier_scan.note: Katawixi: only wordlists/classification (Adelaar 2007, Loukotka 1949); no grammar or phonology exists

sources.citation: Dixon, R. M. W. & Alexandra Y. Aikhenvald (eds.). 1999. The Amazonian Languages (Cambridge Language Surveys). Cambridge: Cambridge University Press. Chapters used: 4 Rodrigues 'Tupí', 5 Jensen 'Tupí-Guaraní', 6 Rodrigues 'Macro-Jê', 7 Barnes 'Tucano', 2 Derbyshire 'Carib', 13 Aikhenvald & Dixon 'Other small families and isolates'.
sources.note: List entry only (source given as Rodrigues 1986); the chapter gives no Katukina phonology. Nothing on prosody.

sources.citation: Gerardi, Fabrício Ferraz, Carolina Coelho Aragon & Stanislav Reichert. 2022. KAHD: Katukinan-Arawan-Harakmbut Database (Pre-release). Journal of Open Humanities Data 8. DOI 10.5334/johd.80 (CLDF/Lexibank dataset with orthography profiles).
sources.source_kind: database or survey citing another work
sources.note: Katawixi is mentioned only historically ('Katawixi was already said to have disappeared in 1926 (dos Anjos, 2011, 16-17)'); Table 2 shows the database's Katukinan doculects are Kanamari (cuti1242) and Katukina do Biá (katu1276) only -- no Katawixi data, no prosodic information.

sources.citation: Ishy de Magalhães, Priscila Hanako. 2018. Kanamari do Juruá (família Katukina): aspectos fonológicos e morfossintáticos. Tese de doutorado, Unicamp (sections 1.2, 1.2.1, 1.2.4).
sources.note: States 'Não há pesquisas linguísticas.. sobre a língua Katawixi. Esta última possui apenas registro de uma lista de palavras e sentenças.' Nothing on Katawixi stress.

sources.citation: Jolkesky, Marcelo Pinho de Valhery. 2016. Estudo arqueo-ecolinguístico das terras tropicais sul-americanas. Tese de doutorado, Universidade de Brasília (sections 4.1.4, Tabelas 25-27; 4.2.1.3.2 'Katukina-katawixi', Tabelas 56-63; 4.2.1.4.1.4.2, Tabela 68).
sources.note: No prosodic content for Katawixi: several dozen Katawixi lexical forms in broad phonemic notation without accent marks (e.g. KTW wahã 'água', miʦa 'arraia', ʧipari 'banana', kirahe 'boca', dahae 'abelha') in lexical-parallel tables; 'acento' never occurs in a linguistic sense in the thesis. Wordlist-type data only.

sources.citation: Adelaar, Willem F. H. & Hélène B. Brijnen. 2015 [issue dated Dezembro de 2014]. Johann Natterer and the Amazonian languages. Revista Brasileira de Lingüística Antropológica 6(2): 333-352.
sources.note: Nothing on Katawixí prosody; same remarks on Natterer's diacritics (Bororo é, Cabixí possibly tonal) and on hiatus = glottal stop/h in the Katawixí items tiki i and to ì (citing Adelaar 2007: 162).

sources.citation: Adelaar, Willem F. H. & Hélène B. Brijnen. 2014. Johann Natterer's Linguistic Heritage. Archiv Weltmuseum Wien (Archiv für Völkerkunde) 63-64 (2013-2014): 162-183 (section 'Sample of Natterer's Wordlists: Katawixí', pp. 167-173; notation remarks pp. 166-167).
sources.note: No stress or tone statement for Katawixí. The only phonetic commentary is (p. 166) that Natterer 'made ample use of diacritic signs, most of which are difficult to interpret today' (é can mark a central vowel in Bororo), that Cabixí 'may have been tonal judging from its structure and the diacritics', and (p. 167) that a hiatus in Natterer's Katawixí notation marks 'an interruption of speech or glottal stop' corresponding to Tastevin's h ('tiki i' = tikihi 'sand', 'to ì' = toñhi 'axe'). The list itself carries Natterer's acute/grave accents on nearly every item, overwhelmingly on the final syl…

sources.citation: dos Anjos, Zoraide. 2011. Fonologia e Gramática Katukina-Kanamari. Utrecht: LOT (section 1.3 'Katawixi', pp. 16-17; Quadro 5, pp. 19-20).
sources.note: Phonology chapters concern Katukina-Kanamari. For Katawixi: 'tem-se apenas um vocabulário recolhido por Tastevin.. uma lista com cerca de duzentas palavras e algumas sentenças'; gives a 20-item word comparison from Tastevin (1920); no stress information.

sources.citation: Deturche, Jeremy. 2010. Finalmente, Tastevin em português (ensaio bibliográfico sobre Faulhaber, P. & Monserrat, R. (orgs.) 2008, Tastevin e a Etnografia Indígena, e Carneiro da Cunha, M. (org.) 2009, Tastevin, Parrissier: fontes sobre índios e sertanejos do Alto Juruá; Rio de Janeiro: Museu do Índio-FUNAI). Campos - Revista de Antropologia Social 11(1): 115-118.
sources.note: No phonology. States that the Bóyusú legend article is probably the only published text with Katawixi ethnographic data, and that 'a maior parte dos dados etnográficos de Tastevin não foi publicada em nenhum artigo e se encontra em manuscritos nos arquivos da ordem.. Esse material, que trata principalmente das populações Kanamari-Katukina, aguarda uma edição crítica', i.e. the Museu do Índio volumes do not print the Katawixi vocabulary.

sources.citation: Hammarström, Harald. 2010. The status of the least documented language families in the world. Language Documentation & Conservation 4: 177-212 (pp. 193-194).
sources.note: Survey only: Tastevin's Katawixi data are 'perhaps enough for a basic grammar sketch' (citing Anjos 2005; Adelaar 2007); no phonological content.

sources.citation: Wichmann, Søren, Eric W. Holman & Cecil H. Brown (eds.). The ASJP Database: Wordlist 'Katawixi' (KATAWIXI; compiled by Zarina Molochieva; source: Adelaar 2007 'Ensayo de clasificación del Katawixí dentro del conjunto Harakmbut-Katukina'). Leipzig/Jena: MPI. Online at asjp.clld.org.
sources.source_kind: database or survey citing another work
sources.note: Wordlist-only data: 40-item Swadesh list in ASJPcode (a5a 'I', ima 'you', ahatsikat3 'we', b3tso 'person', abi diha 'fish', wanka 'dog', baku / bEk3ra 'hand', korombiru 'star', wa 'water', na*5hi 'fire', bohu 'mountain'..). ASJPcode does not encode stress and the list carries no accent marks or prosodic notes; no statement on stress or tone.

sources.citation: Queixalós, Francesc & Zoraide dos Anjos. 2006 [publ. 2007]. A língua Katukína-Kanamarí. LIAMES 6: 29-59.
sources.note: Its 'Acento' sections (5.3, 5.4.3) describe Katukina-Kanamari only. On Katawixí (pp. 31-33) it states the only data are Tastevin's ms. 'Vocabulaire Katawixí et Marawa' (1920a, Chevilly-Larue; c. 200 words and some sentences) plus a second Tastevin ms. in the Fonds Rivet; nothing on Katawixí stress.

sources.citation: Rodrigues, Aryon Dall'Igna. 1986. Línguas brasileiras: para o conhecimento das línguas indígenas. São Paulo: Edições Loyola. 134 pp.
sources.note: Table entry only under the Katukína family (with query); text says the family is as unknown as Txapakúra; nothing on prosody.

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1968. Classification of South American Indian languages. Los Angeles: UCLA Latin American Center (Katukina stock, 'Catauxi or Catosé or Hewadie or Katawishi or Quatausi', pp. 193-194, with comparative table column 'Catauxi'; bibliography: Tastevin ms.a).
sources.source_kind: database or survey citing another work
sources.note: No statement; a handful of Catauxi words in the stock table (tu-kãe 'head', hí-i 'tooth', erada 'eye'..) i.e. wordlist-only, plus the manuscript record 'ms.a. Vocabulaires Katawishi, recueillis à Joanico 1909 et à Renascença 1920. [Original manuscript in ARP.]'.

sources.citation: Loukotka, Čestmír. 1949. Sur quelques langues inconnues de l'Amérique du Sud. Lingua Posnaniensis 1: 53-82 (section 14 'Katauiši', pp. 78-79).
sources.note: Nothing. Prints c. 20 Katawixi words from an anonymous 1921 SPI letter (Manaus archives, copied via Nimuendajú) 'dans la forme originale', with Katukina/Kanamari comparisons; no phonetic or accent remarks.

sources.citation: Rivet, Paul & Constant Tastevin. 1921. Les tribus indiennes des bassins du Purús, du Juruá et des régions limitrophes. La Géographie 35: 449-482 (entry 'Katawisi, Katauixi', pp. 458-459; Katukina group, p. 479).
sources.note: No phonology content. Tribal gazetteer with locations and synonymy ('Catauuixi, Catuxi, Catosé, Catauaxi, Quatauiji, Quatausi'); 'La langue des Katawisi paraît être un dialecte très différencié du Kanamari de notre 2e groupe'; p. 479: the Katukina-group dialects are 'très homogènes, à l'exception du dialecte katawisi, qui est si différencié que nous ne le rattachons aux autres qu'avec réserves, pour le moment du moins'. Nothing on accent or tone.

sources.citation: Verneau, R. 1921. Contribution à l'étude ethnographique des Indiens de l'Amazone (d'après les documents recueillis par le P. Tastevin). L'Anthropologie 31: 255-278 (section 'Les Indiens Katawisi', pp. 272-273; also pp. 256, 258).
sources.note: No phonology content. Ethnographic report based on Tastevin's 28 Aug 1920 report: the Katawisi group numbered about twenty; 'grâce à l'Indien déjà âgé que le missionnaire avait baptisé une dizaine d'années auparavant, celui-ci a pu réunir un vocabulaire assez complet de leur dialecte'; the dialect 'se rattache, comme celui des Kanamari.. à un vieux substratum linguistique indigène' but the two differ 'autant l'un de l'autre, dit le P. Tastevin, que le français de l'anglais'. Nothing on sounds, accent or tone.

sources.citation: Tastevin, Constant. 1919. Quelques considérations sur les Indiens du Juruá. Bulletins et Mémoires de la Société d'Anthropologie de Paris, 6e série, 10: 144-154. doi:10.3406/bmsap.1919.8875.
sources.note: Nothing linguistic: material-culture survey ('Les Kanamaris tirent leur canot de l'ecorce du jutahy; mais les Katauisis et les Marauas font de tres beaux canots en bois.. Les Marawas et les Katawisis font des maisons comme les civilises du pays. Ils sont d'ailleurs civilises eux-memes'). Only the page with the Katawisi hit was read (Persee in-document search returned a single page).
